cases.name: Suzanne Pauswinski
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a 1983 graduate of Forest City High School and had been previously employed in the garment industry having worked for Mussari Dress Factory, Forest City. Suzanne was a very kind and caring person who loved butterflies and especially liked showing off her jewelry. She loved her family and grandchildren very dearly and she will be sadly missed by them."
